# DICOM parser fixtures

These files are test-only and are excluded from the published npm package. They are synthetic
Part 10 instances generated by `tests/dicom/part10-writer.ts`. They contain no patient-identifying
values.

[`corpus.json`](corpus.json) records the exact generator, SHA-256, transfer syntax, and expected
technical tags for every committed binary.

External public corpora may be added later only when they are de-identified, publicly licensed, and
pinned with source URL, revision, license, redistribution status, SHA-256, transfer syntax, and
expected technical tags. pydicom, DCMTK, and GDCM may be used as development oracles; they are not
runtime dependencies.

The fixture writer is not a public DICOM writer.

Pinned raw JPEG 2000 codestreams used by D5 are extracted from development encoder outputs and contain no patient-identifying values:

- `lossless-gray16.j2k` is the `jp2c` payload of `benchmark/corpus/files/jp2/openjpeg-lossless-gray16.jp2` (ImageMagick 7.1.2-3 / OpenJPEG 2.5.3, 9×7 lossless gray).
- `lossy-gray8.j2k` is the `jp2c` payload of an FFmpeg 7.1.1 `testsrc` 8×6 grayscale irreversible JPEG 2000.
